newsitem.title: UK: PRESS-DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS-DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - March 10.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tunisian team visits Saudi Arabia, offers 70 projects worth $1.4 billion to investors.
- The United States urges Gulf Arab states to play effective role in a Middle East economic summit in Doha in November.
- A new route between Dubai emirate in the United Arab Emirates and Iraqi sea ports.
- Third Gulf Arab water conference starts in Muscat.
- Cabinet reshuffle in Libya - three new posts and five newcomers.
- U.S. President to meet Egyptian President Mubarak on Monday.
